title: LLM and GenAI fundamentals
description: Foundation models as breadth: transformer internals, attention variants, KV cache, MoE, tokenization, the training pipeline, post-training methods (SFT, DPO, GRPO, RLVR), PEFT, inference optimization, decoding, evaluation, and multimodal and diffusion models.
